lessons.key: weak_test::when testing a github actions workflow assert failure guards continue on error status functions on every step not only on jobs
lessons.text: When testing a GitHub Actions workflow, assert failure guards (continue-on-error, status functions) on every step, not only on jobs

lessons.key: weak_test::a workflow step that must stop on the first failing command needs an explicit set euo pipefail and a test that forbids a shell override
lessons.text: A workflow step that must stop on the first failing command needs an explicit set -euo pipefail and a test that forbids a shell override

lessons.key: weak_test::to prove a later job reuses a built artifact forbid every command that could rebuild it not only the literal pack command
lessons.text: To prove a later job reuses a built artifact, forbid every command that could rebuild it, not only the literal pack command

lessons.key: ac_gap::a documented procedure must be checked step by step against the guard that enforces it such as a remote branch check
